body:
We've now introduced the `uiState` at the index level. One thing we want to avoid is to subscribe to state change before the `init` step. This step has always been considered as a configuration step for InstantSearch, especially for custom widgets. We don't want to notify of an update at this step. One side effect could be to push a useless entry into the URL history. 

To avoid this issue we delayed the subscription once all the widgets are already initialised. Inside the [`RoutingManager`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/299ffe28006deb516bdc969da8089e703623be6b/src/lib/RoutingManager.ts#L158-L163) we have a similar approach expect that it's performed at the first `render` not after `init`. Not sure to understand why but if we do have issues in the future about sync we could replicate the first render subscription inside the index.

> https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/994/commits/4a672ae3fd78809e213de0368549ef12e9dc9454
title: fix(index): subscribe to state change only after init for uiState
